name: miseshare
description: A tiny, open-source, peer-to-peer screen sharing service.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:client: tsc --project tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2024 --outfile=public/app.js && esbuild src/admin-client.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2024 --outfile=public/admin.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && node --import tsx --watch server.ts
scripts.lint: eslint server.ts scripts src test e2e *.ts *.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build:client && node --import tsx server.ts
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run db:migrate
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build && npm run db:migrate
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run lint && npm run db:check
scripts.verify:fast: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run lint
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
